title: decision(pm): this seat dispatched 5 clause-② reviews at the RETIRED model tier after the maintainer ruling landed — two PRs merged on void verdicts
body:
Ruled: 5770147353 · letter A · 2026-09-22T01:58Z — 一类自裁 (director seat, summon #26); state pm:dispatched, executor domain:spec seat 2

Path: P2 | none | none

**This card reports a failure by the seat filing it.** `domain:spec` execution seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`. Filed into the decision box because the part that is still open — two PRs already in `main` — is above a seat's floor.

## 维护者速读

今天上午你裁了一件事:fable 这个档位没有了,契约复审改用 opus。这条裁决 10:22:54Z 落进主干。

我没有在每场复审前重读那个常量,于是从 10:22:54Z 到 15:27Z 这四小时四十七分钟里,我又派了 **5 场契约复审,全部跑在已经退役的 fable 档上**。按规矩(「降档保险丝」),跑错档的裁决整体作废 —— 不是打个折,是不算数。

后果分三档:

- **两张 PR 已经合并在作废的裁决上**:#19533(11:49Z 合)与 #19594(13:59Z 合)。代码已在主干。
- **两场还在飞**:#19600 的 FAIL 与 #19602 的 FAIL。这两场我作废掉重跑就行,不用你裁。
- **一张没事**:#19549 的复审是 10:21Z 跑完的,那时档位还没改,记录成立。

已经合并的这两张,我不能自己决定怎么补。三个选项在下面,我荐 **A**:现在按 opus 档把这两份已合并的 diff 重跑一遍复审,通过就补记录、不通过就照常立缺陷卡。它是只读的,改不动已经发生的合并,但能把「有没有真出事」从猜变成读数。

请回一个字母:**A / B / C**

## What happened, measured

`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`) is the single value site for the clause-② review tier. Commit `77df0f61a6` (PR #19573) moved it the RETIRED tier → the current `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, landing on `main` at **2026-09-21T10:22:54Z**, on the maintainer's ruling recorded in that constant's own docblock — verbatim 「fable 没有了」, answered with 「改成 opus」.

`references/contract-review.md` 「降档保险丝」 says, verbatim:

> 保险丝只管 spec 与 skills 席的条款②复核:**每场前必读服役档**

and

> 产出裁决的每轮都须读到契约复审档位,**见回退证据 ⇒ 裁决整体作废**

This seat read the constant once, at ~10:10Z, and never again. Every review dispatched after 10:22:54Z went to the retired tier.

Instrument: every subagent transcript this session wrote, counted by `message.model`. **all 37 subagent transcripts this session wrote carry assistant rows, and 0 of the 37 mix models** (21 single-model the RETIRED tier, 16 single-model the current `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), so the per-run reading is not an average over a fallback. LIT CONTROL: the same sweep finds the current `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` runs in the same window (e.g. the 09:56–10:08 run above, and the dev agents), so a the RETIRED tier reading is a real reading of a distinct value and not the only string the instrument can print.

### What is already repaired, ⛔ not waiting on this card

- Both in-flight verdicts (#19600, #15292/#19602) are recorded as VOID on their cards and will be re-run at the current `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Per the fuse, the re-run on the same head cites the voiding and ⛔ is not a re-run seeking a PASS — both were FAILs.
- Their two fail bases were **re-measured first-hand by the seat** before being used at all, so no dev acts on a voided verdict's authority.
- The one at-tier record that stands (#19549's) is annotated rather than voided, with the reason.

## The open question

Two PRs are in `main`, landed against verdicts the fuse says do not count. The fuse assumes the voiding happens before landing and says nothing about after. A seat may not decide what a published contract change owes.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets

- ① 项目长远合理性:A 缩小特例 —— 把「裁决作废」这条规则补上它唯一缺的那半边(合并之后怎么办),不新增例外;C 则等于给作废规则开一个「已经合并就算了」的口子,那个口子以后每次都会被引用。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天没有客户撞上 —— 两张 PR 的门禁全绿、主干未红。拉动来自下一次:如果复审可以事后不算数,契约面的「已复审」三个字就不再是读数。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 的失败是响亮的(重跑出 FAIL 就立缺陷卡);C 的失败是静默的 —— 没有任何人会再看这两份 diff 一眼,而它们进的是 `packages/spec`,正是 AI 照抄的那份说明书。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 是一次性只读动作,不新增长期义务;B 要回滚两张已合并 PR 并重走全程,代价远超已知风险;C 零成本但留下一条永久的软化先例。

Prior rulings read: contract-review-tier,retired-tier,downgrade-fuse,void-verdict → thread: none; ADR: none found; search terms `降档保险丝` / `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` / `裁决整体作废` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `scripts/pm/**`.

## Options × real cost

| option | what is done | what anyone can perceive |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** — post-hoc re-review at the current `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` | Run the clause-② review of #19533's and #19594's **merged** diffs at the current tier. PASS ⇒ record it and the breach is procedural only. FAIL ⇒ each defect becomes an ordinary card. | Read-only; changes nothing in `main` today. Costs two review runs. Turns "did this hurt anything" from a guess into a reading. |
| **B** — revert both, re-land through a correct review | `git revert` both merges, re-open, re-review at tier, re-land. | Maximum rigour. #19594 enrolled a new governed liveness type (`rest_api`) that other work may already read; reverting it churns a published surface over a **process** defect with no measured harm. |
| **C** — accept as landed, record the breach only | Write the ledger and stop. | Cheapest. Leaves two `packages/spec` changes with no at-tier review on record, and sets the precedent that a voided verdict survives if the merge beat the discovery. |

**业务含义直译** —— A = 「出事没出事,先量一遍再说」;B = 「流程错了就整件退货重来」;C = 「已经发出去的就算了,下不为例」。

**推荐:A。** 回退项:若 A 的重跑对任一张判 FAIL 且缺陷是用户可达的,再按 B 处置那一张 —— 而不是现在就对两张都用 B。置信缺口:我没有量过 `rest_api` 这个新活性类型今天有没有被别的在飞工作读到,所以 B 的真实代价我只能说「至少这么多」,不能说「就这么多」。

自检行:只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。
